the symmetry energy and neutron matter equation of state are strongly constrained by neutron star observations, and the role of three-nucleon forces at sub- and supranuclear density is crucial to understand neutron star properties.

the equation of state (EOS) of pure neutron matter and the role of three-nucleon (3N) forces at high densities.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the QMC calculations provide a reliable equation of state of nuclear matter, and the equation of state at supranuclear densities is sensitive to three-nucleon forces.
QMC results are consistent with the recent neutron star observations.

the equation of state and the symmetry energy of neutron matter are very sensitive to the density dependence of the three-body interaction.
the symmetry energy at nuclear matter saturation density is constrained by the combination of the QMC calculations and the recent observations of the neutron star mass.
